maria: Quick sync 1: thinking about refactoring the onboarding pipeline sampling + drift hooks. Need to lock tradeoffs for bench coverage vs cost. Who's around to weigh in?
aj: I'm in. Stratified sampling by seqlen and prompt-type seems high ROI; catches tail perf regressions.
sachin: Can we reuse golden-sampler infra? Duplicating runs will blow budget.
leo: Idea: three gating stages  smoke (sanity), perf (mini-bench), quality (goldset). Smoke must be tiny (<2s) to catch manifest/tokenizer errors.
maria: Concrete: smoke verifies model loads, config, tokenizer mappings, and a tiny inference on 3 seed prompts. Perf runs N samples across buckets, reports p50/p95 latency and per-token cost. Quality runs lightweight goldset eval for regressions.
aj: Where do drift hooks live? Admission path catches early problems but slows iteration. Async post-deploy catches drift but is later in the flow.
sachin: We should hard-fail admission for blatant incompat (tokenizer mismatch, model runtime load errors). Soft drift checks (metric deltas) should be async with alerts and rollback automation.
maria: API contract sketch: onboarding returns gate_status, stage, reasons[], artifacts_url. Machine-friendly, short.
leo: Example config blob (for RFC): ```json
{"smoke_window_s":5, "mini_bench_samples":60, "goldset_eval":true, "kv_warmup_seqlens":[1,8,64,256]}
```
aj: Add KV/cache compatibility smoke: warmup sweep over seqlens and check KV hit-rate and delta-sized caches. Flag significant kv-size increases.
probe-bot: Note: org policy  default mini-bench limit 10m per model. Overrides require eng-ml approval.
maria: We also need canary routing policy: if goldset delta > threshold, route 5% traffic to previous model for 24h, auto-roll back if SLO breaches.
sachin: Also define telemetry tags: onboard.model, onboard.run_id, sample_bucket, bench.stage, bench.run_time.
aj: I'll build a mock Datadog dashboard for p95 deltas, sampling coverage, and goldset metric drift.
maria: Next actions: I'll open a short RFC with API contract, sampling plan, and cost estimate. @aj @sachin please add perf constraints and goldset sizing. Anything else before RFC?
leo: Add a lightweight determinism check: run same small prompt twice and diff logits/topk stability to catch nondeterministic kernels.
sachin: Good call. Also add a small fuzz-run for tokenization edgecases.
maria: Great. I'll post RFC link in channel when done. :rocket:
